title: Exact restriction and the unit for big versus small etale sheaves
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], with small etale site $T_{\mathrm{Et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. In the universe convention [def-weil-size-convention], let $B_T=(\mathrm{Sch}/T)_{\mathrm{Et}}$ be the site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] of all schemes over $T$, all $T$-morphisms, and jointly surjective families of etale morphisms as coverings. Use compatible small presentations in a common larger universe. The inclusion $T_{\mathrm{Et}}\hookrightarrow B_T$ induces a geometric morphism $\pi_T:\mathrm{Sh}(B_T)\to\mathrm{Sh}(T_{\mathrm{Et}})$ [def-trf-geometric-morphism]. On abelian sheaves its direct image is restriction, $(\pi_{T,*}G)(U/T)=G(U/T)$, and is exact. For every abelian sheaf $F$ on $T_{\mathrm{Et}}$, the adjunction unit $F\to\pi_{T,*}\pi_T^{-1}F$ is an isomorphism.

source.place: Tag 0DDI, lemma-cohomological-descent-etale, proof (exactness of pi_* and its underived unit); comparison construction in section-compare.

proof.text: Work in the compatible small presentations in the common larger universe [def-weil-size-convention]. Put $\mathcal C=T_{\mathrm{Et}}$, $\mathcal D=B_T$, and $u:\mathcal C\hookrightarrow\mathcal D$. Check each hypothesis of [lem-trf-bigger-site-retraction]. (a) If $\{V_j\to u(U)\}$ is a big-site covering with $U\to T$ etale, then each $V_j\to U$ is etale, and etale composition [lem-weil-pbc-etale-composition-cancellation](2) makes $V_j\to T$ etale. The same jointly surjective family is therefore a covering in $\mathcal C$ and lifts the given cover, proving cocontinuity. (b) Every small covering is a big covering by the identical definition, and the fibre products along its members are the same scheme fibre products by [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]; thus $u$ is continuous in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology](3). (c) Both sites have all $T$-morphisms between their objects, so $u$ is fully faithful. (d) Fibre products in $\mathcal C$ are scheme fibre products by [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], hence are preserved by $u$. (e) $T/T$ is final on both sides: for every $V/T$ its unique map to $T/T$ is its structure morphism. The inclusion sends this object to itself.

Apply [lem-trf-bigger-site-retraction] to $u$ with the hypotheses checked in step 1. It supplies the morphism of sites $\pi_T=f$ and the geometric morphism $i_T=g:\operatorname{Sh}(T_{\mathrm{Et}})\to\operatorname{Sh}(B_T)$, with $\pi_{T,*}=i_T^{-1}=R$ and $\pi_T^{-1}=L$. In particular restriction on set sheaves is $(RG)(U/T)=G(U/T)$. The site-morphism conventions of [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology](3) give the same precomposition formula on abelian sheaves and on their morphisms. Thus the claimed direct-image formula holds.

Prove exactness of this abelian restriction. The node [lem-trf-bigger-site-retraction] gives $R=i_T^{-1}\dashv i_{T,*}$ on set sheaves; $R$ preserves finite products because it is the inverse image of a geometric morphism. Identify abelian sheaves with abelian group objects by [lem-weil-pbc-sheaf-algebraic-structures-objects], and lift this adjunction using [lem-weil-pbc-adjunction-lifts-group-ring-objects](1),(2). Its lifted left adjoint is exactly abelian restriction: applying $R$ to addition, zero and negation applies the same structure maps on every $U/T$. It therefore preserves cokernels by [lem-weil-pbc-left-adjoint-preserves-colimits], applied to the finite diagram defining a cokernel. Kernels of abelian sheaves are sectionwise by [lem-weil-pbc-sheafification-exact](1), so restriction preserves them as well: $(R\ker(a))(U)=\ker(a(U))=(\ker(Ra))(U)$. Restriction is additive since addition of natural transformations is sectionwise. Hence it is an additive functor preserving kernels and cokernels, which is precisely exactness on these abelian categories.

source.place: Tag 0DDI (lemma-cohomological-descent-etale): pi_* = i^{-1} is exact; Sites 00YV(2), 00XR and 00XU for the adjunction on abelian objects

proof.text: By [lem-trf-bigger-site-retraction], the canonical unit $\eta_F:F\to RLF$ is an isomorphism on set sheaves. This is a statement about the sheafified left adjoint $LF=(u_pF)^\#$, not just about the presheaf $u_pF$: Sites 00XT includes the effect of sheafification using the cofinal coverings supplied by continuity and cocontinuity. Under $R=\pi_{T,*}$ and $L=\pi_T^{-1}$, this is the unit $F\to\pi_{T,*}\pi_T^{-1}F$ of the stated adjunction. For abelian sheaves, [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology](3) states that the abelian unit is the unit on the underlying sheaves of sets. Thus its components are bijective group homomorphisms; their inverse functions are homomorphisms and are natural because the unit is natural. It follows that the abelian unit is an isomorphism as required.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q52-91c8bb1ac (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: I read the whole delivery and pass it with no fixes; review.md has the details. Sources read in full: Stacks 0DDI (whose proof uses pi_* = i^{-1} exact and the identity composite), Topologies 021F and 021G, and Sites 00XR, 00XT and 00XU with their proofs; all tags were checked against tags/tags. The item statement is verbatim the live one and no metadata changed. New node lem-trf-bigger-site-retraction: its hypotheses (a)-(e) are those of 00XU, with u(e_C) iso to e_D, which is harmless. Its conclusions (f_* = g^{-1} = R, f^{-1} = (u_p)^#, the adjunctions L, R, g_*, the unit and counit isomorphisms of 00XT, f o g iso to the identity, f^{-1} fully faithful) say nothing beyond 00XR/00XT/00XU, so the node is true. It is statement-only and unsplit, with correct blueprint from/via and same_as []. It is the general site theorem, not a restatement of a clause of the item. It is not a duplicate: lem-weil-pbc-continuous-cocontinuous-topos-adjunction gives only the 00XR adjunction, with no full-faithfulness hypothesis and no unit or counit isomorphism. Mathlib has no match: CoverLifting and Pullback give no unit isomorphism without cover-density. Item step 1 checks 00XU (a)-(e) for T_Et inside (Sch/T)_Et as 021G does: etale composition gives cocontinuity, def-weil-pbc-etale-site gives fibre products, and full faithfulness and the final object T/T hold. Step 2 gives pi_* = restriction on abelian sheaves through def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology(3). Step 3: R is a left adjoint that preserves finite products; lifting it to group objects (adjunction-lifts (1),(2)) gives cokernels, sectionwise kernels give kernels, so R is exact. Step 4 takes the set-level unit isomorphism from the new node and the abelian unit = underlying set unit from def(3). Edge cases checked: T empty, the zero sheaf, u = id, and a non-full u, where 00XT fails. Accepted tool uses: etale-composition-cancellation, sheaf-algebraic-structures-objects, adjunction-lifts-group-ring-objects, left-adjoint-preserves-colimits and sheafification-exact(1). No SGA source is used and no target is weakened.
